title: Chat Optimizer
description: Chat Optimizer is a client-side Minecraft chat mod boosting efficiency.
body:
# Chat Optimizer ✨

A lightweight client-side mod designed to improve the Minecraft chat experience for greater comfort and convenience~  
*This mod is entirely written by AI.* (◍•ᴗ•◍)

---

## 💖 Features

- **Timestamps** – Adds `[HH:mm:ss]` to every incoming message (local only, toggleable) 🕒
- **Chat History** – Auto-saves up to 1000 messages per server, reloads when you rejoin 📜
- **Local Search** – `/chatoptimizer search <keyword>` – filter by player or message content 🔍
- **Unlimited Input** – Removes the 256-char limit, supports up to 65536 chars (configurable) 💬
- **Right-Click Copy** – Right-click any message to copy its full text 📋
- **Auto Commands** – Run commands like `/login` automatically after joining a server 🤖
- **Format Preservation** – Keeps colors, click events, and JSON formatting in history 🎨
- **Visual Settings UI** – A pretty GUI to tweak everything 🖥️

---

## 📥 Commands

All commands start with `/chatoptimizer`:

| Command | What it does |
|---------|---------------|
| `help` | Shows help |
| `toggle` | Turns all features on/off at once |
| `status` | Checks each feature's state |
| `timestamp on/off` | Enables/disables timestamps |
| `history` | Shows history status |
| `history clear` | Clears history for current server |
| `history recordmode all/chat_only` | Sets record mode (all messages / chat only) |
| `search [keyword]` | Opens search GUI |
| `autocommand` | Opens auto-command menu |
| `autocommand list` | Lists all saved auto commands |
| `autocommand add <command>` | Adds a new auto command (must start with `/`) |
| `autocommand remove <command>` | Removes an auto command |

**Example** 🌟  
`/chatoptimizer autocommand add /login 123456`

---

## 📝 Little Notes

- Client-side only – no need to install on server 🎮
- Chat history is saved per server IP in `config/chat_optimizer_mod_1781247740/history/` – please back up if you need it 💾
- Auto-command encryption is **on by default** (hardware‑bound) 🔒
- Action bar messages (the ones in the lower middle of screen) are **not logged** 🚫
- Only the most recent 1000 messages are kept per server (oldest get auto‑deleted) 🗑️
